title: session_started
description: Watch → phone. The wrist's report that a session just started on the wrist, emitted by the start path itself — a planned tap or a free start — and not by the engine's generic start, so a start from a routine button sends nothing new. The report is durable: a start report the radio cannot carry is handed to the OS queue and delivered when the two devices meet. Named ids travel only when known.

sessionId.description: The wrist's own session id; the phone stores the link under its own minted id.

routineTemplateId.description: The routine the tapped plan was created from. Omitted (never null) when the start is a free workout.

plannedSessionId.description: The tapped plan's id. Omitted (never null) when the start is a free workout.
